title: Market Share Shift
description: BYD experienced significant growth in 2024, selling 4.27 million vehicles and achieving a 32% share of China's new energy vehicle market. In contrast, Tesla's revenue decreased by 8.69% to $21.30 billion in March 2024, and its market share fell from 60% in 2020 to 38% in 2024.
